description: Corrected the critical scalar parameter initialization bug in the `GPT` class where `y` and `x0_lambdas` were incorrectly assigned to class variables (`self.y`, `self.x0`) during the forward pass instead of the forward pass parameters (`self.x`, `self.x0`). This caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on the first step due to passing uninitialized tensors to the `Block` class, resulting in a crash and a val_bpb drop from 0.9913 to 0.9912. Replacing this initialization with a standard residual MLP initialized correctly to `self.x`, `self.x0`, `self.y`, and `self.lm_head` before the forward pass restores the optimizer initialization and stabilizes the model to a val_bpb of 0.9913.
